YOUR QUESTIONS ANSWERED

Before you start.

Find out how we can help remotely.

Do you provide remote support in Belo Horizonte?

Yes. Top Info BH handles IT requests in Belo Horizonte following an assessment and appointment. The computer must turn on and be connected to the internet.

What do I need to receive support?

A computer that turns on and connects to the internet. During the initial conversation, we explain how to prepare and which remote access tool to use.

Can remote access take place without my authorization?

No. Access is arranged with you and requires your permission. You can follow the work on screen and end the connection.

Do I need to share my digital certificate password?

Enter passwords and PINs yourself when needed, without sending them in messages. We arrange this step during the session.

Can every problem be solved remotely?

Software and configuration issues can be assessed remotely. Physical faults, equipment that will not turn on or a total lack of internet may require in-person service.

How much does support cost?

The quote depends on the issue and the service required. Contact Top Info BH on WhatsApp for an assessment and agree on the price before starting.

Do you support PJe for any court?

Tell us which court and system you use and share the error message, if any. We assess compatibility and available support for your setup. Court system outages depend on the court restoring service.
